name: Egg in the tower nest
summary: A literal Easter egg in a nest at the top of the tallest tower in Vice City, which can be picked up and thrown.
body: GameSpot says the egg sits in a nest on top of the tallest tower in Vice City, and that the player who found it said the climb took about seven minutes.
GameSpot says Jason or Lucia can take the egg from the nest and throw it, and leaves what follows unspoiled; it does not name the tower.

name: New Austin western novel
summary: A readable western novel about a cowboy in New Austin, one of several nods to Red Dead Redemption.
body: GameSpot says several items across the map tie Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption to one universe, one being a western novel about a cowboy living in New Austin, a place from the Red Dead series.
GameSpot says the copy it pictures is in Jacob's Tavern in Millport, and that excerpts of books and magazines like this one can be read in the game.

facts.region: Jacob's Tavern, Millport, among other places

name: Liberty City mob memoir
summary: A memoir by a former Liberty City crime figure, found on Jason's table early in Chapter 1, that mentions 2008.
body: GameSpot says a memoir written by a former member of Liberty City's organised crime ring lies on the small table near the back door of Jason's home early in Chapter 1.
GameSpot says the book mentions events of 2008, which it reads as a link to Grand Theft Auto IV, set in that year, and that copies appear in other places too.

facts.region: Jason's house, Key Lento, among other places
